questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully centered (around 00:08), there are clearly three pens lined up.
All three pens are oriented vertically with their capped ends pointing towards the bottom of the frame.
The leftmost pen is blue, while the middle and right pens are black/dark grey. They are not all the same color.
All pens appear to have their caps on; none show an exposed tip or look significantly shorter.
The board moves smoothly from left to right without stopping or reversing.

parsed.reason: The video shows a blue pen alongside two black pens, violating the nominal condition that all three pens must be identical in color.

description: One pen differs in color from the other two.
